items.title: Show HN: P(bloom), an Omarchy theme with 42 blueprint style wallpapers
items.contentSnippet:
Hi all!
My name is Jacek Becela, this is my first Show HN.
I wanted to create blueprint wallpapers for my desktop and got a bit carried away. These were created along the way:
- 42 unique wallpapers, each in 3 color intensity versions, 18 resolutions and aspect ratios giving in total 2268 files (~700MB) served on demand from Cloudflare R2
- the color theme, 
- music video with two genre options
- a companion app for downloading the versions correct for your screen.
